name: @amykit/plugin-plan-check
description: The quality bar for a drafted plan: the repository's own check, run in its checkout.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it with note-to-plan, which checks every plan it drafts before proposing it. It mounts the plan-check port and the check-plan action, and runs the repository's own check commands in the plan's checkout, so a plan only goes forward once the repository's own bar passes.
